project: Mario Sports Mix native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays a Basketball exhibition's tutorial match at 60 fps, no graphics errors seen. All nine of the game's code modules run as native code. Tested on Windows 11 and on the Linux mini PC by playing into the first real scene (mini PC: the Basketball tutorial match, 60.0 fps, no frame over 20 ms). With the current runtime version the game was started and run through its menus again on the mini PC (no stops, frame times as before); the scene named here was played with the version before. Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
